anchor.semantic_hook: Creating petty grievances becomes the physical manufacture of tiny quarrels by a hand-cranked machine.
anchor.setting: An empty shared workroom contains project tables, office chairs, supply shelves, and a central hand-cranked dispute machine. Its chute releases pairs of thimble-sized boxing gloves that hop toward each other and spar without wearers; every other object behaves normally. A doorway opens onto a quiet corridor.
anchor.absurd_element: a crank machine producing pairs of tiny self-sparring boxing gloves

inserts.action: stands on one side of the project table with an irritated frown, pointing down at a single misplaced pencil

variations.scene_adjust: an unfinished office project, one misplaced pencil, and two coffee cups on the central table

inserts.action: leans across the table with an exasperated face and one finger raised toward her companion
leans back toward her with both palms spread in protest, eyes fixed on the same trivial object

variations.scene_adjust: an afternoon clock with unnumbered face and a single disputed stapler between them

inserts.action: turns away from the machine with weary eyes, both palms lowered in a firm request for calm
pauses with one hand hovering over the crank, shoulders tense and mouth ready to object

variations.scene_adjust: the dispute machine temporarily still with its crank held halfway down

inserts.action: waits beside an incomplete project structure, holding out a needed tool with mounting frustration
turns his back on the project and cranks the dispute machine eagerly, absorbed in the tiny fight

variations.scene_adjust: an incomplete group project structure, scattered components, and one needed tool

variations.scene_adjust: an unplugged speaker, padded slippers, and a clock with slowly moving hands in the silent workroom

variations.scene_adjust: two school backpacks and one small pull-toy beside the active dispute machine
